sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim of this module is to study Corporate Finance for Managers. Traditional concepts from Corporate Finance are examined in the context of contemporary issues.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand the role of Accounting in Corporate Finance. B Appreciate traditional concepts from Corporate Finance and how they apply in different business contexts. C Recognize the advantages and risks of different sources of funding. D Analyze contemporary issues in the context of Corporate Finance.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Lectures, class discussion, reflective exercises, and group work are used to study the practical application of key concepts in Corporate Finance.
